dedupe_keys.name: offgridai data centre power cost model

description: OffGridAI's calculator models a data centre supplied by solar generation, batteries and gas generators. Its README describes fetching weather for a chosen latitude and longitude, simulating power flow among equipment and a specified data-centre load, then calculating annual cash flows and levelised cost of energy. Users set location, equipment capacities, operating and capital costs; outputs include LCOE, renewable share and scenario tables or a Pareto frontier. Geographic coverage is any location supported by its weather source and inputs. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that fuel cost, reliability, generator emissions and interconnection constraints depend on user assumptions; a cost result is not a vetted site design. The model can compare hybrid supply configurations for digital infrastructure scenarios. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model handles broader energy-system pathways. No weather data, CSV scenario output or application package was downloaded.
inputs: Site weather, data-centre load, generation and battery capacities, costs
name: OffGridAI data-centre power cost model
notes: G7 G7-1809. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
outputs: Power-flow schedule, annual cash flow and LCOE
